metadata.title: ख़तरनाक द्वीप पर कितने आदिवासी, थर्मल तकनीक से गिन पाएंगे | Thermal Technique to Count Sentinelese
metadata.description:
Can technology solve one of the biggest mysteries of the Andaman Islands?
This discussion explores the challenges of counting the Sentinelese tribe of North Sentinel Island, a community completely isolated from the modern world.
With the government considering thermal imaging and AI-based methods for the upcoming census, experts debate how accurate or ethical this approach really is.
Should technology step in, or should their privacy remain untouched?
